brief.headline: Russia touts Odesa port strangulation; Ukrainian drones hit Yalta, Krasnodar
brief.lead: Channels celebrated Russian strikes shutting down Odesa exports (Maersk halt) while reacting angrily to Ukrainian drone attacks on Yalta, Krasnodar and Wildberries warehouses; sentiment on Ukrainian strikes swung sharply negative.

developments.title: Odesa port strikes claimed to halt Maersk, Ukrainian exports
developments.body: Multiple channels amplified claims that Russian strikes on Odesa/Chornomorsk port infrastructure, warehouses, fuel and two cargo ships forced Maersk to halt operations, cutting Black Sea traffic to 'three ships daily.' Poddubny also claimed destruction of two Neptune launcher units. Unconfirmed and channel-sourced.

developments.title: Ukrainian drones hit Yalta, Krasnodar; net sentiment collapses
developments.body: Channels reported a Ukrainian drone strike on a Yalta residential building (17 wounded, 3 critical, 350 evacuated) and mass attacks on Krasnodar/Stavropol, including burning Wildberries warehouses with 'billions in damages' and civilian deaths. MoD claimed 123 drones destroyed. Topic scored net -100 (a 38-point swing).

developments.title: Channels amplify Ukrainian command shakeup and 'crisis'
developments.body: Rybar noted Syrsky's replacement by Drapaty, saying it won't fix numerical/supply problems; WarGonzo and Kotsnews framed the firing of Defense Minister Fedorov as triggering a 'mutiny' and loss of Zelensky's control. Kotsnews cited polls showing Zaluzhny/Fedorov out-polling Zelensky. Framing serves Kremlin narrative of Ukrainian collapse.

developments.title: Frontline gains claimed near Zaporizhzhia, Kupyansk
developments.body: Poddubny and Kotsnews claimed capture of Blagodatnoye (Zaporizhzhia) and Artelnoe (near Kupyansk/Kharkiv); Rybar reported advances near Belyy Kolodets and pressure across the Oskil. WarGonzo cited Hulyaipole-direction gains toward Mirnyi. Unconfirmed, channel-sourced.

developments.title: Fuel-market strain acknowledged even as Putin reassures
developments.body: Kotsnews and Poddubny relayed Putin calling fuel difficulties 'temporary' with no economic impact, while Two Majors claimed Azerbaijan is replacing Russian energy exports to Europe due to refinery damage, and Starshe Eddy conceded no air defence stops all drones. A rare cluster of economic unease.

developments.title: Nord Stream sabotage pinned on Ukraine, US 'direction'
developments.body: Two Majors claimed German court documents confirm Ukrainian special forces/SBU involvement in the Nord Stream sabotage 'under US direction.' Aligns with parallel MFA/Lavrov claims that the US directs Ukrainian strikes on Russian civilian targets. Single-channel on the court claim.

narrative_watch.title: 'US directs strikes on Russian civilians'
narrative_watch.body: Lavrov, the MFA (via Poddubny) and Two Majors' Nord Stream framing converge on portraying the US as directly steering Ukrainian attacks, pre-positioning blame for civilian casualties on Washington.

narrative_watch.title: Calls to target Ukrainian grain/agriculture
narrative_watch.body: Multiple channels (Starshe Eddy, Poddubny, Kotsnews) advocate striking grain terminals, silos and logistics to 'cut Ukrainian military financing' — normalising escalation against food/export infrastructure.

narrative_watch.title: 'Ukraine defrauds Russian children for apartment keys'
narrative_watch.body: A near-identical claim about Ukrainian fraud schemes targeting Russian children to obtain apartment keys appeared across Rybar, Two Majors, Poddubny and Kotsnews, indicating a coordinated domestic-threat message.

mood_lines.text: Uniformly triumphant (net +100); Odesa port shutdown and Maersk halt treated as a decisive economic blow to Ukraine.
Sharply negative (net -100, down 38); Yalta casualties and burning Krasnodar warehouses drove anger and damage-tallying.
Positive; claimed captures at Blagodatnoye and Artelnoe plus drone-kill vignettes, though Kupyansk described as unclear.
Mixed; gloating over Iran hitting US bases and Ukrainian command chaos offset by unease at US aid and NATO expansion.
Split; FSB arrest and drone tech touted, but fuel-market strain and export displacement acknowledged with visible discomfort.
Negative; complaints government cannot defend all infrastructure, urging private firms to protect economic objects themselves.

flag_texts.title: Ukraine-strikes sentiment plunges to -100
flag_texts.body: The 'Ukraine strikes on Russia' topic swung 38 points to a fully negative net (-100) across 13 posts, driven by the Yalta residential strike (17 wounded) and burning Wildberries/Krasnodar warehouses framed as economic and civilian damage.

flag_texts.title: Mobilisation and Putin criticism stay silent
flag_texts.body: Watchlist items 'Mobilisation rumours' and 'Criticism of Putin' saw no posts; criticism instead targeted government infrastructure defence, while Putin was quoted reassuringly on the fuel market.
